// Notes: Single source of truth for voice / VAD / transcription / model / api-version is ContactCenterAgent.Shared.VoiceLive.VoiceLiveDefaults. This file holds ONLY secrets, endpoints, and per-environment overrides. To change a default value used by both caller-agent and danish-voice-lab, edit VoiceLiveDefaults.cs (NOT this file). To override a default for prod only, add the corresponding key here, e.g.:  'AzureOpenAI:DeploymentName' (model A/B), 'AzureOpenAI:ApiVersion', 'Voice:Name', 'Voice:Temperature', 'Voice:Style', 'Voice:Locale', 'VoiceLive:Vad:Threshold', 'VoiceLive:Vad:SilenceDurationMsOther', 'Transcription:Model', 'Transcription:Language'.
